caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of an intricately designed object, likely made of metal, with a symmetrical, openwork pattern. The main object, shown in perspective in the foreground, starts with a circular handle adorned with swirling, interwoven elements, followed by two parallel bars that lead to a larger, leaf-shaped section filled with an elaborate arrangement of looping and interlacing motifs. Above this perspective view, there is a flattened, overhead view of the same object, displaying its shape and pattern clearly, as well as a side view showing its profile and two support legs. Below the side view is a small ruler for scale. The drawing is rendered in shades of black and gray on a beige background. The lower left corner contains the script "Filippo Peresa."
title: Flat Iron Holder
